Together these grant full tenant access; a route would require a master secret vulnerable to logs, screenshots, or `curl` shell history, plus rotation, rate limits, and caller audit. When a Pipe admin UI exists, it can call `provisionarCliente` through a session-authenticated route with a dedicated role and audit.
